role: The /xp command: adds experience points, or levels when the amount ends in l/L (negative removes levels).
scope_reason: Commands never run in this game: the product has no chat text entry (no chat handling in csrc/play/play.c) and no harness path constructs ServerCommandManager (grep of oracle/harness finds none); the behaviors the project needs are the Dev ops of oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/Dev.java and csrc/engine/dev.c, not this command system.

members.name: processCommand
members.note: the Dev 'xp' op adds levels (clamping negative to zero total) or points via csrc/engine/survival.c:surv_server_add_xp, mirroring addExperienceLevel/addExperience

notes: Static __OBFID constants are grouped out per the brief.
